sources_used.source: US Business Directory - Fords (bulk; only letters A-I rendered)
Google Maps (browser, town and zip-anchored category searches)
Web search results (Yellow Pages, BBB, Angi, Nextdoor, trade and industry directories)

categories_thin: Retail (group D): Fords retail is a small New Brunswick Ave strip - no independent furniture, clothing, bicycle, music or gift shops surfaced in map, directory or web searches
Group D education: only dance schools and two driving schools were found; no tutoring centres, music schools or art schools in the zone
Hotels: the only lodging in the zone is the branded Best Western / Iconnect complex at 1050 King Georges Post Rd - no independent inn or motel found
Self-storage, moving, pest control and tire categories are dominated by chains (Extra Space, Public Storage, Storage Rentals of America, Mavis) - only independents are listed
Keasbey is almost entirely industrial and distribution, with no retail or personal-service businesses; Hopelawn is a small blue-collar neighbourhood with roughly a dozen eligible trades businesses
caveats: Google Maps listings often show a street address without the town; those towns were assigned from the map pin coordinates relative to the Fords/Hopelawn/Keasbey boundaries and are flagged in notes where inferred

The US Business Directory (us-business.info) is a bulk compilation with no review activity on any entry; a share of its Fords/Hopelawn/Keasbey entries are likely stale, so entries sourced only from it are marked as one-directory evidence for triage to confirm
Several Fords contractors share addresses (428, 440 and 552 New Brunswick Ave; 720 King George Rd is an office building with dozens of suites) which look like shared, virtual or co-working addresses

Several same-address pairs are flagged as possible rebrands of one shop (669 King Georges Rd; 834 King George Rd; 387 New Brunswick Ave; 526 New Brunswick Ave; 280 St Stephens Ave; 511 New Brunswick Ave) - treat each pair as one prospect until confirmed

Chain and franchise locations seen and deliberately excluded: Mavis Discount Tire, JAN-PRO, Extra Space, Public Storage, Storage Rentals of America, The Home Depot, Lowe's, Harbor Freight, Walmart, Amazon XNJ2, FedEx Ground, Wakefern, Republic Services, Skanska, Synnex, Haier America, Praxair, Union Carbide, Tilcon, Wabash National, Woodbridge Dodge, KeyMe, Minute Key, The UPS Store, Enterprise Rent-A-Car
The Best Western entry at 1050 King Georges Post Rd is a franchised brand; it is listed with a flag rather than excluded because the property appears locally owned
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, Cylex, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com, D&B, whereorg, localitybiz and hub.biz all returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches, so their town-level category lists could not be pulled
The US Business Directory page for Fords only rendered letters A-I in the fetchable HTML; J-Z entries for Fords could not be retrieved and are therefore missing from this list
OpenStreetMap Overpass API (overpass-api.de and two mirrors) timed out - no OSM business dump or town polygons for the zone
Google Maps serves a limited view of roughly 8-12 results per query, so very small home-based trades with weak map presence may be missing
Woodbridge Township publishes no online licensed-business directory for these neighbourhoods

The Census and Nominatim geocoders could not resolve most house-number addresses in Fords/Hopelawn/Keasbey (OSM lacks address points), so a few town attributions rest on street-name and map-pin reasoning rather than an authoritative geocode

Phones were not captured where Google masked the number: Most Valuable Plumber, Integrity Remodeling, Good Heart Cleaning, Red Trim Painting, Plastipak, Simple Human, United Distribution Service, NFI Distribution, E-Z Wheels Driving School
